Attached: 4 images

Draft, edit, send: a 15-minute workflow. Pick one real piece of writing, draft it in 3 minutes with the reader, ask, and tone, edit for voice in 5, check the facts in 3, then send it and save what worked in 4. The draft is a start, not a send — if you would not sign it, do not send it. Link in bio. #AIexplained #smallbusiness #productivity
